title: RCP Dish Profile
description: Hardened dish profile (SR-PROF-004; DS-PROF-002; PRD-002 FR-PROF-004), created 2026-08-02 from exactly two real documents (chili con carne, feijoada de marisco — n=2). Hardened means closed to observed use: neither document carries a profile block, declares bases, or exercises any dish-specific numeric invariant, so the profile block is closed-empty and x-rcp-bounds is deliberately empty. NOTHING here is speculative. When bounds do arrive (third+ real dish), they enter at warn severity only per the recorded riskiest assumption — warn-severity bounds are advisories, never rejections (severity routing in the facts pipeline); promotion to error severity requires more real documents and a decision entry.

profile.description: Closed-empty at n=2: neither real dish document uses a profile block. Admitting a field here requires observed use in real documents — a schema conversation, not authoring freedom.
